content:
maria_cs: Weekly Northwave health check — summary below; flagging p95/p99 splits by route & model (streaming vs non-streaming), errors, spend. posting raw numbers then quick asks.

devon_se: thanks — drop the raw numbers pls, quick glance only.

maria_cs: sure. raw snapshot (last 7d):

Route: /chat (model: rw-gen-2b)
 streaming p95: 210ms  p99: 470ms
 non-stream p95: 430ms  p99: 910ms

Route: /generate (model: rw-gen-8b)
 streaming p95: 340ms  p99: 760ms
 non-stream p95: 780ms  p99: 1600ms

Errors: 0.32% (5xx + client errors), baseline last week 0.12%
Spend: $72.4k (W/W +12%)
Requests: 1.2M tokens served
Onboarding: 75% complete (agent flows live, docs remaining)
Renewal signal: engaged but raising perf concerns

ashok_infra: notable that non-stream p99 is ~2x streaming p99 across both routes. looks like KV cache misses + large seq lengths. any recent model switches? 

maria_cs: no model switch. Northwave increased prompt length on 3/10 after adding multi-turn context. that pushed seq median from 256 -> ~820 for a subset.

julia_ops: error rate bump — do we have correlated traces? e.g., timeout spikes or infra errors?

devon_se: logs show a burst of 503s around 03:15 UTC x2 during a deploy window. same time as a warmup job failing for one dedicated pool.

kevin_eng: can confirm: autoscaler mis-applied for dedicated pool northwave-prod-1, caused queueing. rollback fixed it at 03:22. impact concentrated in /generate (large model).

maria_cs: impact window small but hit p99. customers noticed latency. Northwave CS rep said they saw UI freezes on a sales demo yesterday -> they flagged renewal concern.

ashok_infra: immediate actions I can take:
- pin route /chat -> prefer streaming runtime (already enabled for most traffic)
- increase reserved burst for northwave-prod-1 during business hours
- backfill KV caches for long-context flows

maria_cs: thanks. also suggest enable quick batching cap for /generate non-stream, set max_batch_ms to 20 for peak.

devon_se: noted. I'll push config change to staging and monitor traces for 24h. tagged @ops_bot to create an alert for p99 > 800ms on /generate.

ops_bot: Alert created: northwave:/generate:p99 > 800ms (window 5m). Pager if > 3 occurrences in 1h.

julia_ops: for CS enablement: propose a customer-facing doc summarizing best practices to reduce latency & spend (prompt trimming, prefix caching, streaming where possible, quantized model variant). I'll draft and sync with Northwave next Tue.

maria_cs: please do. also prepare a one-slide summary for their renewal convo: 1) what happened, 2) mitigations + timeline, 3) expected perf lift if they adopt streaming & 8-bit quantized variant.

kevin_eng: FYI: quantized variant rw-gen-8b-q8 shows ~30% token-cost reduction and median latency down ~18% in internal bench. need to confirm quality with their eval set.

devon_se: can run a quick eval against their sample prompts if we get a small corpus from Northwave. ask CS to request.

maria_cs: action items:
- ashok: apply burst + cache backfill (ETA 2h)
- devon: config change to batch cap on /generate (ETA 1h) and run eval once corpus arrives
- julia: draft enablement doc + slide (ETA Tue)
- kevin: prepare perf/quality summary for q8 variant (ETA EOD)

kevin_eng: noted.

maria_cs: renew risk labeled: medium. if metrics normalize in 72h and we show plan + quick wins, should move to low. if not, escalate to AM for credits discussion.

devon_se: monitoring dashboard links:
- p95/p99 split: https://redwood.metrics/northwave/latency
- errors: https://redwood.metrics/northwave/errors
- spend: https://redwood.metrics/northwave/spend

maria_cs: thanks everyone. I'll update Northwave after ashok & devon confirm mitigations. ping if you want me to loop PM/AM.

ashok_infra: mitigation done: increased burst cap + warmed caches. initial p99 for /generate dropped to 610ms in last 15m.

devon_se: batch cap change deployed to canary; saw tail improvement ~12% on non-stream p99. pushing to prod now.

maria_cs: great. I'll schedule a quick sync with Northwave CS and include the slide before Tue. closing this thread unless new regressions appear. :thumbsup:
